_doc: STAGING. Rerun Season rebuilt vocabulary-first. The bench REFUSED the old list as production-crew jargon — pilot, rerun, tape, cued, bombed is a call sheet — and pointed out that the living-room seat watches the syndication marathon, not the crew. Re-listed around what a viewer sees and says, and the boards are written from the couch.

theme.name: Rerun Season
theme.blurb: Four episodes back to back on a Saturday, and you know every line before it lands.
